description: This file contains unit tests for the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class within the OpenID Authentication plugin, specifically testing its methods related to social media authentication workflows in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class, testing social media OAuth flows, user authentication, and provider interactions within the OrangeHRM OpenID plugin environment.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Validates that the service returns an instance of AuthProviderDao.

methods.name: testInitiateAuthentication
methods.description: Tests the process of initiating authentication, verifying the returned client configuration such as secret, ID, scopes, and redirect URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectURL
methods.description: Ensures the redirect URL generated for authentication matches expected URL.

methods.name: testGetScope
methods.description: Checks that the correct OAuth scope string is returned.

methods.name: testGetUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of User entities based on credentials, verifying correct user IDs and account status.

methods.name: testSetOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Validates assignment of user identity based on OpenID Connect provider information.

methods.name: testHandleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Simulates handling of an OIDC authentication response, verifying successful user authentication flow.
